answer: Reaching the spiral of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a long technical clauses, numbers at the end register, it stays short. The pigment holds work receipts rather than names, so the terrace of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on retroactive public goods funding mechanisms.
